verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing platform that documents automations, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence only describes building automations and triggered journeys, with nothing on version history, change review or rollback. Pricing claims such as 'all your data stay intact' concern the account after a trial ends and say nothing about automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
